stages.title: Concept
stages.copy: Frame the opportunity through sketches, references, use cases, and story.
stages.imageAlt: Stock reference: a sketchbook and pencil

stages.title: Design
stages.copy: Resolve form, proportion, interaction, and structure through deliberate iteration.
stages.imageAlt: Stock reference: a product designer sketching

stages.title: Model
stages.copy: Build accurate digital systems, assemblies, characters, or construction logic.
stages.imageAlt: Stock reference: a laptop displaying a 3D model

stages.title: Analyze
stages.copy: Evaluate stress, deformation, and structural behavior through finite element analysis to guide design refinement.
stages.imageAlt: Illustrative finite element mesh with a color gradient showing structural stress distribution

stages.title: Prototype
stages.copy: Test the idea through physical, digital, or sequential versions and refine it.

stages.title: Visualize
stages.copy: Make the result clear through rendering, animation, diagrams, or instruction.
stages.imageAlt: Stock reference: a rendered isometric room

stages.title: Present
stages.copy: Deliver a coherent, presentation-ready outcome built for its next context.
